intent: Port only remaining F4 SMC mixer behaviour from #688/#788 onto #789: clock-phase feedback, clip strip-8 stage navigation and SELECT8 MIX cycling. Preserve keyboard independence, captured lock targets, drum/FX ownership and HOME modifiers. Keep qualification gates separate from source review.

findings.suggested_fix: Exclude the exact unlocked clip-stage navigation predicate from smc_button() action classification. Add a drum MIX/SEQ clip-mode case asserting stage movement without a RECORD/SOLO popup; execute only on the authorized box.
findings.title: Clip navigation reopens a false drum action popup
findings.why_it_matters: With unlocked drum MIX/SEQ on bank 1, REC8 or SOLO8 in clip mode changes the clip stage, then reopens a RECORD or SOLO popup. The action classifier runs before navigation and restores the popup after the clip helper cancels it. The performer sees feedback for an action that did not occur, covering the selected stage.

findings.title: Assert header rendering through real transport transitions
findings.why_it_matters: A regression that hides the icon while stopped or waiting can pass the written tests. Assert both header paths after those transitions, including two WAIT blink phases.
